Among these shipments were: 💊 Chlorine tablets shipped by the @IOM 🫁 CPAP devices by @UNICEF 🔧 Generator spare parts by @UNDSS 🩺 Ultrasound devices by the @WHO 🧪 Medical laboratory equipment by the @WHO 💧 Water containers by the @ICRC COGAT coordinates the entry of this equipment together with the international community to strengthen the medical and WASH response on the ground.
